description: Otto brings business travel bookings into GPT. Search flights and hotels, compare options, then book your choice. Your preferences filter search results (cabin class, seat, hotel brand, airline), and your loyalty numbers attach to reservations. When plans change, exchange or cancel a flight or hotel. It retrieves trip details on request: flight times, hotel addresses, confirmation numbers.
